## 1. Overview

OMA is an AI inference gateway with OpenAI-compatible API. Pay with crypto, use 50+ models.

```
User ──► OMA API ──► Venice AI / AntSeed / LiteLLM
         │
         └── Credits deducted per request
```

### Base URL
- **Local Dev:** `http://localhost:3001`
- **Production:** `https://api.oma-ai.com`

### Key Features
- OpenAI-compatible endpoints
- 50+ AI models
- Multi-provider failover (Venice → AntSeed → LiteLLM)
- Rate limiting per API key
- Streaming support
- Cross-chain crypto deposits via HoudiniSwap
- x402 payment protocol support

---

## 2. Setup Requirements

### Required Services

| Service | Purpose | Sign Up |
|---------|---------|---------|
| **Venice AI** | Primary AI provider | https://api.venice.ai |
| **PostgreSQL** | User/credit storage | https://neon.tech (free tier) |
| **WalletConnect** | Wallet connection (optional dev) | https://cloud.walletconnect.com |

### Environment Variables

**Server (`server/.env`):**
```env
# REQUIRED
DATABASE_URL=postgresql://user:pass@host:5432/database
JWT_SECRET=your-super-secret-key-at-least-40-characters-long
VENICE_API_KEY=sk-your-venice-api-key

# SERVER CONFIG
PORT=3001
CORS_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000
NODE_ENV=development
FACILITATOR_MODE=mock

# OPTIONAL (for rate limiting)
REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379
```

**Frontend (`app/.env.local`):**
```env
NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:3001
NEXT_PUBLIC_WALLETCONNECT_PROJECT_ID=your_walletconnect_project_id
NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_TREASURY=0xYourTreasuryAddress
```

## 3. API Endpoints

### Health Check

```http
GET /health
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "status": "ok",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "service": "oma-ai",
  "correlationId": "abc123"
}
```

---

### Authentication

#### Get SIWE Nonce
```http
POST /auth/nonce
Content-Type: application/json

{ "address": "0x..." }
```

**Response:**
```json
{ "nonce": "abc123xyz..." }
```

#### Verify SIWE Signature
```http
POST /auth/verify
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "message": "oma-ai.com wants you to sign in with your Ethereum account:\n0x...",
  "signature": "0x...",
  "type": "siwe"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "token": "eyJhbG...",
  "address": "0x..."
}
```

#### Wallet Connect (Get API Key)
```http
POST /auth/wallet
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "message": "...",
  "signature": "0x..."
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "apiKey": "oma_sk_xxxxxxxxxxxx",
  "prefix": "oma_sk_xxxx",
  "id": "uuid",
  "name": "Default wallet key",
  "createdAt": "2026-05-22T..."
}
```

---

### API Keys

#### List Keys
```http
GET /keys
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
```

#### Create Key
```http
POST /keys
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{ "name": "Production" }
```

#### Delete Key
```http
DELETE /keys/:id
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
```

### Inference (OpenAI-Compatible)

#### Chat Completions
```http
POST /v1/chat/completions
Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "llama-3.3-70b",
  "messages": [
    {"role": "system", "content": "You are a helpful assistant."},
    {"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}
  ],
  "temperature": 0.7,
  "max_tokens": 1000,
  "stream": false
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "id": "chatcmpl-xxx",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "created": 1747852800,
  "model": "llama-3.3-70b",
  "choices": [{
    "index": 0,
    "message": {
      "role": "assistant",
      "content": "Hello! How can I help you?"
    },
    "finish_reason": "stop"
  }],
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 20,
    "completion_tokens": 15,
    "total_tokens": 35
  }
}
```

#### Streaming Response
```http
POST /v1/chat/completions
Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "llama-3.3-70b",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Count to 5"}],
  "stream": true
}
```

**Response:** `text/event-stream`
```
data: {"id":"...","object":"chat.completion.chunk","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"One"},"finish_reason":null}]}

data: {"id":"...","object":"chat.completion.chunk","choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"content":"Two"},"finish_reason":null}]}

data: [DONE]
```

#### List Models
```http
GET /v1/models
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "models": [
    {
      "id": "claude-opus-4-7",
      "category": "frontier",
      "inputPricePer1M": 15.0,
      "outputPricePer1M": 75.0,
      "maxTokens": 200000,
      "displayName": "Claude Opus 4.7",
      "capabilities": ["chat", "coding", "reasoning", "vision"]
    },
    ...
  ]
}
```

#### Embeddings
```http
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "embed-english-v3.0",
  "input": "The quick brown fox"
}
```

#### Image Generation
```http
POST /v1/images/generations
Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "flux-schnell",
  "prompt": "A cute cat",
  "n": 1,
  "size": "1024x1024"
}
```

#### Text-to-Speech
```http
POST /v1/audio/speech
Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "speech-1",
  "input": "Hello, world!",
  "voice": "alloy"
}
```

**Response:** Binary audio (mp3/wav)

#### Video Generation
```http
POST /v1/videos/generations
Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "seedance-2-0-text-to-video",
  "prompt": "A sunset over the ocean",
  "duration": "5s"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "id": "vid_abc123",
  "object": "video",
  "status": "processing",
  "queue_id": "abc123"
}
```

#### Retrieve Video
```http
GET /v1/videos/retrieve?queue_id=abc123
```

### Web Search

OMA provides real-time web search through the Tinyfish provider. Credits are deducted per search.

#### Search
```http
GET /v1/search?query=latest+AI+news
Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "position": 1,
      "site_name": "TechCrunch",
      "title": "OpenAI Announces GPT-5",
      "snippet": "OpenAI has announced...",
      "url": "https://techcrunch.com/..."
    }
  ],
  "query": "latest AI news",
  "total_results": 42
}
```

#### Streaming Search
```http
GET /v1/search/stream?query=latest+AI+news
Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
```

**Response:** `text/event-stream`
```
data: {"type":"result","position":1,"site_name":"TechCrunch","title":"...","snippet":"...","url":"..."}

data: [DONE]
```

```http
POST /v1/credits/purchase
Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "amountCents": 10000,
  "paymentMethod": "usdc",
  "autoReload": false
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "creditsAdded": 10000,
  "expiresAt": "2027-05-22T...",
  "depositId": "dep-xxx",
  "paymentMethod": "usdc",
  "autoReloadEnabled": false
}
```

{

### Deposits

OMA supports multiple deposit methods: USDC direct, HoudiniSwap (cross-chain), CCTP (Circle Cross-Chain Transfer Protocol), and LiFi (multi-chain).

#### USDC Deposit (Base)
```http
POST /v1/deposit/usdc
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "amount": 1000000,
  "txHash": "0x...",
  "signature": "0x..."
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "credits": 1000000,
  "depositId": "dep-xxx"
}
```

#### USDC Deposit (Solana)
```http
POST /v1/deposit/usdc
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "amount": 1000000,
  "txHash": "solana_tx_hash",
  "network": "solana"
}
```

#### HoudiniSwap Quote
```http
POST /v1/deposit/houdini/quote
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "fromToken": "ETH",
  "toToken": "USDC",
  "amount": "1000000000000000000",
  "swapType": "standard"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
[
  {
    "quoteId": "houdini-quote-id",
    "fromToken": "ETH",
    "toToken": "USDC",
    "fromAmount": "1000000000000000000",
    "toAmount": "1950000",
    "rate": "0.00195",
    "estimatedTime": 0,
    "swapType": "standard",
    "slippage": 1
  }
]
```

#### HoudiniSwap Exchange
```http
POST /v1/deposit/houdini/exchange
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "quoteId": "houdini-quote-id",
  "fromCoin": "ETH",
  "fromAmount": "1000000000000000000",
  "refundAddress": "0x..."
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "depositId": "dep-xxx",
  "depositAddress": "0x...", 
  "orderId": "houdini-order-id",
  "fromAmount": "1000000000000000000",
  "toAmount": "1950000",
  "status": "pending",
  "expiresAt": "2026-05-22T..."
}
```

#### HoudiniSwap Tokens
```http
GET /v1/deposit/houdini/tokens?blockchain=ethereum
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "tokens": [
    { "symbol": "ETH", "address": "0x...", "chain": "ethereum" },
    { "symbol": "USDC", "address": "0x...", "chain": "base" }
  ]
}
```

#### HoudiniSwap Chains
```http
GET /v1/deposit/houdini/chains
```

#### HoudiniSwap Webhook (for status updates)
```http
POST /v1/deposit/houdini/webhook

Content-Type: application/json

{
  "type": "swap",
  "depositId": "dep-xxx",
  "toAmount": "1950000",
  "txHash": "0x...",
  "status": "FINISHED"
}
```

#### HoudiniSwap Payment Link
```http
POST /v1/deposit/houdini/payment-link
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "amount": 50,
  "token": "USDC",
  "chain": "base"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "depositId": "dep-xxx",
  "paymentLink": {
    "id": "pl-xxx",
    "url": "https://pay.om.ai/link/...",
    "amount": "50",
    "token": "USDC",
    "chain": "base",
    "expiresAt": "2026-05-23T...",
    "status": "pending"
  }
}
```

### Onramp (Fiat to Credits)

OMA supports fiat onramping with a processing fee.

#### Get Onramp Quote
```http
POST /v1/onramp/quote
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "amountUsd": 100
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "amountUsd": 100,
  "processingFeeUsd": 2.9,
  "netUsd": 97.1,
  "credits": 9710,
  "rate": 100
}
```

#### Create Onramp Session
```http
POST /v1/onramp/session
Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "amountUsd": 100,
  "successUrl": "https://app.oma.ai/success",
  "cancelUrl": "https://app.oma.ai/cancel"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "sessionId": "sess-xxx",
  "amountUsd": 100,
  "credits": 9710,
  "status": "pending"
}
```

#### Get Onramp Session
```http
GET /v1/onramp/session/:id
Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
```

#### Onramp Webhook (provider calls this)
```http
POST /v1/onramp/webhook
X-Onramp-Signature: <hmac_signature>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "sessionId": "sess-xxx",
  "status": "completed"
}
```

Admin endpoints require authentication with an admin wallet address.

#### List Users
```http

**Response:**

      "totalRequests": 150

    "page": 1,
    "limit": 50,
    "total": 100,
    "pages": 2

}
```

#### Get User Detail
```http
GET /admin/users/:id

```

```http

```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "period": "30d",
  "summary": {
    "totalRequests": 15000,
    "totalInputTokens": 500000000,
    "totalOutputTokens": 250000000,
    "totalRevenue": 5000.00,
    "totalCost": 3000.00,
    "grossProfit": 2000.00,

}
```

```http
GET /admin/revenue?period=30d
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
```

#### List All API Keys
```http
GET /admin/keys?page=1&limit=100

```

## 5. Authentication

### Option 1: Wallet (SIWE)
1. Connect wallet (MetaMask, WalletConnect, etc.)
2. Sign SIWE message
3. Get session token
4. Use session to create API keys

### Option 2: API Key (For API Usage)
1. After wallet connect, create API key
2. Use API key in `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header
3. Key format: `oma_sk_xxxxxxxxxxxx`

### Option 3: Account Number (Mullvad-style)
For non-crypto users:
1. Create account number (Dashboard)
2. Login with account number
3. Same as wallet flow

---

## 6. x402 Payments

x402 is a protocol for per-request crypto payments without pre-funding.

### Flow

```
1. Agent requests quote
   POST /v1/x402/quote
   { model, inputTokens, fromToken, fromChain }

2. OMA returns quote with total cost
   { quoteId, fromAmount, totalCostUsd, expiresIn }

3. Agent creates deposit
   POST /v1/x402/deposit
   { quoteId }

4. OMA returns deposit address
   { orderId, depositAddress, expiresAt }

5. Agent sends tokens to deposit address

6. Agent polls for settlement
   GET /v1/x402/deposit/:orderId/status

7. Once settled, agent calls inference via proxy
   POST /v1/x402/proxy/chat/completions
   X-Houdini-Order-Id: <orderId>
```

### Get x402 Quote
```http
POST /v1/x402/quote
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "deepseek-v4-flash",
  "inputTokens": 1000,
  "fromToken": "ETH",
  "fromChain": "ethereum",
  "swapType": "standard"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "quoteId": "quote_xxx",
  "fromToken": "ETH",
  "fromChain": "ethereum",
  "fromAmount": "100000000000000000",
  "toAmount": "5000000",
  "toToken": "USDC",
  "routingFee": "500000",
  "facilitatorFee": "75000",
  "totalCostUsd": "5.75",
  "expiresIn": 60
}
```

### Create x402 Deposit
```http
POST /v1/x402/deposit
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "quoteId": "quote_xxx",
  "refundAddress": "0x..."
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "orderId": "order_xxx",
  "depositAddress": "0x...",
  "fromToken": "ETH",
  "fromAmount": "100000000000000000",
  "toToken": "USDC",
  "status": "pending",
  "swapType": "standard",
  "expiresAt": "2026-05-22T..."
}
```

### Check x402 Deposit Status
```http
GET /v1/x402/deposit/:orderId/status
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "orderId": "order_xxx",
  "status": "settling",
  "houdiniStatus": "CONFIRMING",
  "fromAmount": "100000000000000000",
  "toAmount": "4950000",
  "txHash": null
}
```

### x402 Proxy (Direct Inference with Payment)
```http
POST /v1/x402/proxy/chat/completions
X-Houdini-Order-Id: order_xxx
Authorization: Bearer <api_key>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "deepseek-v4-flash",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]
}
```

### x402 Verify (Check Payment)
```http
POST /x402/verify
PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: {"signature":"0x...","payload":{...}}
```

### x402 Chains
```http
GET /v1/x402/chains
```

### x402 Tokens
```http
GET /v1/x402/tokens?blockchain=ethereum
```

### x402 Headers (for direct proxy)

```http
POST /v1/x402/proxy/chat/completions
X-Houdini-Order-Id: order_xxx
PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: {"orderId":"order_xxx","amount":5000000,"networkId":"base"}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "deepseek-v4-flash",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]
}
```

### Supported Chains for x402

- Base (primary)
- Solana
- Ethereum
- Arbitrum
- Optimism
- Polygon
- Avalanche
- BSC
- And 20+ via HoudiniSwap

## 7. Teams API

Teams allow multiple wallets to share credits and manage permissions.

#### List Teams
```http
GET /teams
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "teams": []
}
```

#### Create Team
```http
POST /teams
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "My Team"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "team": {
    "id": "team-1",
    "name": "My Team"
  }
}
```

#### Get Team
```http
GET /teams/:teamId
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
```

#### Add Team Member
```http
POST /teams/:teamId/members
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "address": "0x...",
  "role": "member"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "member": {
    "address": "0x...",
    "role": "member"
  }
}
```

---

## 8. SSO/SAML API

Enterprise SSO for team-based authentication.

#### Create SSO Connection
```http
POST /sso/connections
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "teamId": "team-1",
  "provider": "okta",
  "domain": "company.com"
}
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "connection": {
    "id": "conn-1",
    "teamId": "team-1",
    "provider": "okta",
    "domain": "company.com"
  }
}
```

#### List SSO Connections
```http
GET /sso/connections/:teamId
Authorization: Bearer <session_token>
```

**Response:**
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "connections": []
}
```

#### SAML Assertion Consumer Service (ACS)
```http
POST /sso/saml/acs
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

SAMLResponse=base64_encoded_saml_response
```

This endpoint receives SAML assertions from identity providers and issues session tokens. After successful authentication, it redirects to the application dashboard.

## 9. Testing Guide

### Health Check
```bash
curl http://localhost:3001/health
```

### Test Inference
```bash
# Get an API key from dashboard first
curl -X POST http://localhost:3001/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer oma_sk_your_key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "deepseek-v4-flash",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Say hi in one word"}]
  }'
```

### Test Streaming
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3001/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer oma_sk_your_key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "deepseek-v4-flash",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Count to 3"}],
    "stream": true
  }'
```

### Test Web Search
```bash
curl "http://localhost:3001/v1/search?query=hello" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer oma_sk_your_key"
```

### Test Balance
```bash
curl http://localhost:3001/v1/balance \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer oma_sk_your_key"
```

### Test List Models
```bash
curl http://localhost:3001/v1/models
```

### Test Deposit Quote
```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3001/v1/deposit/houdini/quote \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer oma_sk_your_session_token" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "fromToken": "ETH",
    "toToken": "USDC",
    "amount": "1000000000000000000"
  }'
```

### Run Tests
```bash
# Server tests
cd server && npm test

# App tests
cd app && npm run test
```

## 10. Example Code

### Python (OpenAI SDK)

```python
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(
    api_key="oma_sk_your_key",
    base_url="http://localhost:3001/v1"
)

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="llama-3.3-70b",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
)

print(response.choices[0].message.content)
```

### JavaScript/Node.js

```javascript
const response = await fetch('http://localhost:3001/v1/chat/completions', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': 'Bearer oma_sk_your_key',
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    model: 'deepseek-v4-flash',
    messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello!' }]
  })
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data.choices[0].message.content);
```

### cURL

```bash
curl -X POST http://localhost:3001/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer oma_sk_your_key" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "llama-3.3-70b",
    "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "What is 2+2?"}]
  }'
```

### Web Search Example

```python
import fetch

response = await fetch("http://localhost:3001/v1/search?query=latest+AI+news", {
    "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer oma_sk_your_key"
    }
})
data = await response.json()
print(data["results"])
```

### Streaming Search Example

```javascript
const response = await fetch("http://localhost:3001/v1/search/stream?query=hello", {
  headers: { "Authorization": "Bearer oma_sk_your_key" }
});

const reader = response.body.getReader();
const decoder = new TextDecoder();

while (true) {
  const { done, value } = await reader.read();
  if (done) break;
  
  const chunk = decoder.decode(value);
  for (const line of chunk.split("\n")) {
    if (line.startsWith("data: ") && !line.includes("[DONE]")) {
      const data = JSON.parse(line.slice(6));
      console.log(data.title, data.url);
    }
  }
}
```

### x402 Payment Flow Example

```python
import json

# Step 1: Get quote
quote_response = await fetch("http://localhost:3001/v1/x402/quote", {
    "method": "POST",
    "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
    "body": json.dumps({
        "model": "deepseek-v4-flash",
        "inputTokens": 1000,
        "fromToken": "ETH",
        "fromChain": "ethereum"
    })
})
quote = await quote_response.json()
print(f"Quote: {quote['totalCostUsd']} USD")

# Step 2: Create deposit
deposit_response = await fetch("http://localhost:3001/v1/x402/deposit", {
    "method": "POST", 
    "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
    "body": json.dumps({"quoteId": quote["quoteId"]})
})
deposit = await deposit_response.json()
print(f"Deposit address: {deposit['depositAddress']}")

# Step 3: Poll for settlement (in real implementation, agent sends tokens first)
import asyncio
for _ in range(60):
    await asyncio.sleep(1)
    status_response = await fetch(f"http://localhost:3001/v1/x402/deposit/{deposit['orderId']}/status")
    status = await status_response.json()
    if status["status"] == "completed":
        print("Payment settled!")
        break

# Step 4: Make inference request with payment header
inference_response = await fetch("http://localhost:3001/v1/x402/proxy/chat/completions", {
    "method": "POST",
    "headers": {
        "Authorization": "Bearer oma_sk_your_key",
        "X-Houdini-Order-Id": deposit["orderId"],
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    },
    "body": json.dumps({
        "model": "deepseek-v4-flash",
        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}]
    })
})
```

### Cross-Chain Deposit via HoudiniSwap

```python
# Get quote
quote = await fetch("http://localhost:3001/v1/deposit/houdini/quote", {
    "method": "POST",
    "headers": {"Authorization": f"Bearer {session_token}"},
    "body": json.dumps({
        "fromToken": "ETH",
        "toToken": "USDC", 
        "amount": "1000000000000000000"
    })
})

# Create exchange order
exchange = await fetch("http://localhost:3001/v1/deposit/houdini/exchange", {
    "method": "POST",
    "headers": {"Authorization": f"Bearer {session_token}"},
    "body": json.dumps({
        "quoteId": quote[0]["quoteId"],
        "fromCoin": "ETH",
        "fromAmount": "1000000000000000000",
        "refundAddress": "0xyourwalletaddress"
    })
})

print(f"Send {exchange['fromAmount']} ETH to: {exchange['depositAddress']}")
```

### OpenAI SDK Migration

```python
# BEFORE (OpenAI)
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(api_key="sk-...", base_url="https://api.openai.com/v1")

# AFTER (OMA)
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(api_key="oma_sk_xxx", base_url="http://localhost:3001/v1")
```

---

## Error Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|------|---------|
| 400 | Bad request - invalid parameters |
| 401 | Unauthorized - invalid API key |
| 402 | Payment required - insufficient credits |
| 404 | Not found - model doesn't exist |
| 409 | Conflict - duplicate transaction |
| 410 | Gone - quote expired |
| 429 | Rate limit exceeded |
| 500 | Server error |
| 502 | Bad gateway - external service error |
| 503 | Service unavailable - all providers down |

---

*Permissionless inference. Pay with crypto. No account required.*
